One of the two banners carried by [[Perrin]]'s men, the other being the [[Red Wolfhead Banner]]. It was the same as that of ancient [[Manetheren]], consisting of a red eagle flying across a field of blue.{{ref/book|4|53}}{{ref/book|9|26}} It was used by Perrin in [[Altara]] to distract from his real intentions. Perrin put it aside when he reached an alliance with the [[Seanchan]].
